subject: Request: One-off POC credit + extension for SurgeCare (procurement delay)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@surgecare.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@surgecare.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, david.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: One-off POC credit + extension for SurgeCare (procurement delay)

Liam / Priya —

Thanks for the update on procurement. I understand the PO path is going to take another 2–3 weeks on your side; appreciate you working it. Given the timeline and the fact that your engineers are already deep in the integration, we want to avoid losing momentum.

Quick ask: would SurgeCare accept a one-off upfront credit grant (120,000 tokens equivalent / sandbox uplift) paired with a 45-day extension of the POC window? We’d condition the credit on receiving a signed PO within 30 days of the credits being applied; if the PO does not arrive, we’d convert the credit to an invoiceable discount to be reconciled.

Rationale: this is a strategic regional health system (fast path to production, likely >$1M ARR year one if the pilot meets latency/cost targets) and competitors are already engaging. We typically don’t offer credits this large on PLG trials, so I’ll need a short exec sign-off. I’ve attached the SOW and the draft PO that you shared.

If you’re aligned, I’ll escalate for CXO approval internally — ideally today so we can keep the kickoff sprint on Monday. Please confirm if Procurement can commit to signing within 30 days.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SurgeCare_SOW_v1.pdf, PO_pending_98344.pdf

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@surgecare.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@surgecare.com>, Procurement <procurement@surgecare.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-off POC credit + extension for SurgeCare (procurement delay)

Naomi —

Appreciate the transparency. We are definitely interested in keeping the current engineering sprint running. Procurement is the choke point; they need a PO on file to release any vendor credits against their university account. Priya and I spoke to Procurement and they said if we provide a PO today they can sign within 10 business days, but their process won’t start until our CFO signs off on the internal spend.

If Redwood can front the credits to avoid a stop-gap, we will push hard to get a PO and sign within 30 days. That would be ideal. Happy to have Procurement loop directly with your legal/finance teams to expedite.

—Liam
Liam O'Neill
CTO, SurgeCare Health
liam.oneill@surgecare.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-off POC credit + extension for SurgeCare (procurement delay)

Naomi —

Thanks for pulling this together. Short thoughts from Deal Desk / Sales Ops:
- The economics look favorable if the conversion assumptions hold (you listed ~1M ARR conservative).
- This is clearly outside standard PLG credit envelope (we cap automatic grants at ~15k tokens).
- We should make any credit conditional and timeboxed: e.g., credits applied, 30-day PO commitment, and an automatic invoice if no PO.
- Legal/Finance will want a short addendum to the SOW to capture the contingency and recovery mechanism.

I recommend escalating to David (CRO/CFO?) for one-off CXO approval. If David signs off, Sales Ops can draft the addendum and get Legal to review same day.

If helpful, I can summarize the customer exec metric (expected cadence, target latency, pilot KPIs) in one pager.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Executive approval requested: SurgeCare one-off credit (120k) + 45-day POC extension

David —

Short and urgent ask: can I get your one-time approval to grant SurgeCare 120,000 tokens of free credit and a 45-day extension to their POC? Details below and attached.

Why this matters:
- Strategic upside: SurgeCare is a regional health system consortium; projected Year-1 ARR > $1M if pilot meets throughput/latency targets.
- Momentum: Engineers are mid-integration; without credits they will pause work until Procurement issues a PO (estimated 2–3 weeks). Competitor X is already scheduled for a demo next week.
- Risk control: Grant is conditional — credits applied now; customer must provide a signed PO within 30 days. If PO not received, credits are converted to an invoice and reconciliation will occur per SOW addendum.

Operational notes:
- Sales Ops (Karthik) will produce an addendum capturing the contingency clause. Legal is briefed and can turn around review within 48 hours.
- Finance is aware of the ask; we will track as deferred revenue until PO arrives.
- Attachments: SOW and the draft PO SurgeCare sent.

Requested approval options (please reply with one):
1) Approve full ask: 120k credits + 45-day extension (preferred)
2) Approve half: 60k credits + 30-day extension
3) Deny — we follow standard PLG limits and pause active work until PO arrives

Time sensitivity: customer is asking we proceed by EOD tomorrow to avoid stall. Please reply with the option you approve and any conditions. I can jump on a 15-minute call if helpful.

Thanks for the quick review — appreciate it.

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SurgeCare_SOW_v1.pdf, PO_pending_98344.pdf
